description: This chart consists of three pie charts, labeled “easy”, “medium”, and “hard”, representing the distribution of question types—specifically, the combinations of “N” and “K” attributes—within each difficulty level. Each pie chart contains four slices. In the “easy” chart, the slices represent N+K+ (40.6%), N-K+ (45.9%), N-K- (10.1%), and N+K- (3.3%). The “medium” chart shows N+K+ (44.6%), N-K+ (44.3%), N+K- (7.2%), and N-K- (3.9%). Finally, the “hard” chart displays N+K+ (36.2%), N-K+ (20.1%), N-K- (36.8%), and N+K- (7.0%). Each chart includes a legend identifying the color associated with each N/K combination, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices in each chart appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest slice.
